lines.text: There is three? Say there are!
Many learners say: There is three students here.
Better: There are three students here.
Are! There are four books here.

data.memory: There are two. There are three.

native.tip: «يوجد» لا تتغيّر مع العدد في العربية، أما هنا فنقول there are: “There are three students here.” وليس “There is three students here.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “There is three students here.” 😅 «يوجد» لا تتغيّر مع العدد في العربية، أما هنا فنقول there are، فالجملة الصحيحة “There are three students here.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “are” — «يوجد» لا تتغيّر مع العدد في العربية، أما هنا فنقول there are. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: «يوجد» does not change for more than one in Arabic, but here we say there are: “There are three students here.” not “There is three students here.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “There is three students here.” 😅 «يوجد» does not change for more than one in Arabic, but here we say there are, so the right sentence is “There are three students here.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
